description: Price one condition for the estimate — the canvas Estimate panel's rows. A condition has one estimate line per quantity kind it carries (its area, LF and EA — see estimate_summary); the first is its MAIN line. unit is what the main line is bought in (SF, SY, LF, EA). line picks WHICH line material and labor price: leave it out (or pass the main line's unit) for the main line; pass "LF", "EA" or "SF" (a second area line prices in SF) to price that other line — one call per line. material and labor are $ per that line's unit: material is priced on the ORDER quantity (waste applied — SY is the waste-adjusted SY), labor on the MEASURED quantity (no waste); EA carries no waste on either. materials prices the condition's supporting-material rows (from edit_materials) per THEIR unit (bag, pail, roll) — quantities are already whole packages. null clears a price back to "not entered"; 0 is an explicit $0 (owner-furnished material, labor-only scope). A bordered linear run's derived second line (its LF when the border SF is the main line, or the reverse) is OPTIONAL: it shows and can be priced, but left empty it is carried in the main line, never missing. Every price comes from the estimator or a document they gave you — never invent, estimate or 'typical' one; a price nobody entered stays unentered and estimate_summary names it. The reply carries the line this call priced (line) and all of the condition's lines (lines), with a note naming any line still unpriced. Rides export_takeoff into the app; undo_last reverses the call.
